title: Double arrows DOWN when BGs are going UP !!
symptom: AAPS displays double DOWN arrows even though BG numbers are going up, while the BG source (xDrip) shows the correct arrow. The issue occurs intermittently and is resolved by restarting the phone.
cause: The thread identifies the cause as related to the smoothing algorithm in AAPS, as the problem occurs when smoothing is enabled and stops when it is disabled. The issue may be triggered by jumpy BG readings.
fix: The fix is to disable the smoothing algorithm in AAPS, or restart the phone as a temporary workaround. A commit was made to address the issue.
evidence_quote: I confirm that it is smoothing related. Smoothing was off thill this morning. I set it back ON and an hour later, I get the double down arrows...
